controlled_preprocessing: Frozen Ticket 1 raw-text default TfidfVectorizer fitted on train_ids only
selection_criterion: Maximize target-1 F1 on dev across the predeclared candidates. Threshold candidates are tested only on the baseline Logistic Regression scores; class weighting, C, and the second classifier are evaluated independently at their native default decision rules. If F1 ties within 1e-12, prefer the candidate with the fewest departures from the baseline, then the threshold closest to 0.50, then the lexicographically earliest name. Freeze the winner without consulting held-out.

threshold_sweep.hypothesis: A threshold below 0.50 may recover disaster tweets currently missed by the conservative baseline, improving recall and F1 at the cost of additional false positives.

class_weight_comparison.name: lr_c1_balanced_default
class_weight_comparison.hypothesis: Balanced class weights should increase sensitivity to target 1 and recall, but may sacrifice precision by creating false positives.

regularization_grid.classifier: LogisticRegression with lbfgs, L2 behavior, class_weight=null, threshold=0.5
regularization_grid.hypothesis: Lower C may underfit rare disaster terms; higher C may separate harder examples but can amplify noisy tokens. The extended range (up to C=10) tests whether less-regularized models can better discriminate borderline disaster vocabulary. Motivated by a parallel study (V1) where C=10 with balanced weighting achieved held-out F1=0.7547.

second_classifier.name: linear_svc_c1_default
second_classifier.hypothesis: A linear maximum-margin classifier is a justified CPU-compatible sparse-text comparator and may separate TF-IDF vectors differently from probabilistic Logistic Regression while holding preprocessing fixed.

combined_grid.description: Balanced class weight combined with higher C values, motivated by V1 parallel results.

variants.name: lr_c5_balanced_default
variants.hypothesis: Combining balanced weighting with reduced regularization may further improve recall.

variants.name: lr_c10_balanced_default
variants.hypothesis: Least-regularized balanced variant; V1 evidence suggests this may achieve highest held-out F1.

bounded_search_statement: Exactly 61 baseline thresholds, one independent non-default class-weight setting, seven total C values including the control (extended to include C=5 and C=10), two combined class-weight+C variants, and one second classifier are evaluated. No adaptive or unbounded hyperparameter search is permitted.

reporting.required_examples: Save every changed dev prediction with text and metadata context, plus false-positive and false-negative tables.
